literal_meaning: হারা (পরাজয় বা ভাগ) এবং হারি (ভাগাভাগি বা সমান বিভাজনের ধারণা থেকে)
figurative_meaning_en: Division or sharing according to average or proportion
example_sentences_in_english: We will share the expenses equally.
The property will be divided proportionally.
note: Refers to fair and equal distribution in everyday Bengali transactions
